name: Rock-Hewn Churches of Ivanovo
description: High above the Rusenski Lom River in northeastern Bulgaria, about 20 km south of Rousse, hermits began carving cells and chapels straight into the cliff face in the 12th century. The churches and monasteries sit roughly 32 metres up the rocky bank. Inside, vivid 14th-century frescoes by artists of the Tarnovo School remain remarkably well preserved.
